Name: AT Penny's Rugs
Author: orochifrogu
Description:
Do you want your to embrace Penny's style even more? Or do you simply just want some new, larger strawberry rugs? Try my mod 'Penny's Rugs [AT]'!

[size=4]Check out [/size][size=4][url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qINy-COTIUk]my youtube video [/url]where I showcase this mod in a quick 2 minute trailer[/size]

I have created 2 versions (original and green) of 3 different sized carpets, 6 in total, all to fit in with Penny's original 'Fruit Salad Rug'! They are all ranging in size as you can see in the images and also I think they could work in christmas settings as well :)

This mod requires Alternative Textures! The textures are for: Blossom Rug, Funky Rug and Large Green Rug! 

HOW TO INSTALL:
1. make sure you have SMAPI and Alternative Textures downloaded
2. download my file
3. unzip my file into your 'mods' folder
you will now have the ability to use these alternative textures of the rugs!!

WHAT OTHER FURNITURE MODS ARE SHOWN IN PICS?
-orangeblossom's Windows and French Doors (door and window)
-orangeblososm's vintage furniture (just the book pile on ground in bedroom)
-orangeblossom's basic bedroom (lamp, candle on side table)

WHAT ELSE AM I WORKING ON?
-I have a 'cute' rugs pack coming out, all in cuter themes and cuter colours. pink, cyan, lilac, light green, baby blue etc. lots of flowers etc
-Still working on my Sebastian Black Butler Dialogue expansion, and I presume it shall be ready by the 16th or so of May! SO very soon!
-I am working on my next character sprites/portrait overhaul for Clint (Berserk themed)

ANY SUGGESTIONS/ISSUES?
pls leave me a comment! I reply to everyone and I love seeing what you think! If you have any suggestions or there's something youve wanted in a visual mod and like my art style, let me know!! I am ready to tackle some new ideas!
